messages.content: You are a terse coding agent. Use tools when asked. Answer in one sentence.
Count the lines of notes.txt and notes2.txt. Call exec_command twice in the SAME turn, in parallel: 'wc -l notes.txt' and 'wc -l notes2.txt'. Then report both counts in one sentence.

function.name: exec_command
